changes.change: Elon Musk said a full Starlink Mobile carrier network in the US will take 2 or 3 years, after Verizon's CEO estimated at least 4 to 6.
Verdict: Partial → Delivered late. Tesla's Full Self-Driving (Supervised) now follows highway on-ramps and exits without the driver holding the wheel, using the cabin camera for attention.
Verdict: Missed → Delivered late. SpaceX's third-quarter results showed AI revenue at $7.6 billion, ahead of Starlink and launch combined.
Verdict: Missed → Delivered late. Tesla confirmed Optimus production has begun on Fremont high-volume lines, after the July/August start it had targeted.
Verdict: Missed → Delivered late. Dragon first reached the space station in May 2012, about a year and a half after the 2010 target.
Verdict: Missed → Cancelled. Tesla discontinued Solar Roof in August 2026, so the Spanish-tile and French-slate styles that never shipped are now shelved.
Verdict: Missed → Cancelled. Tesla killed Solar Roof in August 2026, ending the 1,000-roofs-a-week production goal.
Verdict: Pending → Partial. Tesla confirmed Optimus production on the converted Fremont high-volume line, still far short of a million robots a year.
Elon Musk said Tesla may release a video of Optimus doing unscripted tasks in a month or two.
Elon Musk said Tesla is aiming for 5 million vehicles a year by about 2030.
Elon Musk said he would be surprised if EU-wide FSD approval takes longer than the first quarter of 2027.
Elon Musk said Tesla's AI5 chip should go into Optimus around April 2027.
Elon Musk said Terafab aims to make useful chips at volume around the third quarter of 2028.
Elon Musk said Fremont's Optimus line should reach 20,000 robots a week in at least a year, maybe a little longer.
Elon Musk said Tesla expects to start delivering Optimus to companies outside Tesla around the end of 2027.
Elon Musk said Starship should fly weekly in the first half of 2027 and twice weekly or more by the end of 2027.
Elon Musk said Starship Flight 15 should fly next month and will try to catch both the booster and the ship with the tower.
Elon Musk said Grok Bot should be in wide deployment for enterprise customers within a few weeks.
Elon Musk said Starlink will probably have about 100 times its current bandwidth within three years.
Elon Musk said SpaceX's annual recurring revenue should be between $500 billion and $1 trillion by the end of 2027.
Elon Musk said SpaceX plans to have a 440,000-chip Vera Rubin training cluster online by the end of Q2 2027.
Elon Musk said SpaceX is on track to bring about 200,000 GB300 chips online every month for the rest of 2026.
Elon Musk said he expects SpaceX to have about 13 gigawatts of AI compute online by the end of 2027.
Elon Musk posted that next year he will give one of his SpaceX shares to every kid in America, and that it will be the first of many.

Verdict: Pending → Delivered. Tesla's Oct 15 2026 Roadster reveal showed the SpaceX thruster package: the Rocket trim has 10 cold-gas thrusters around the car, the ~10 Musk promised in 2018 (TechCrunch).

Verdict: Pending → Delivered. At the Oct 15 2026 reveal Tesla listed sub-one-second 0-60 for the Roadster Thrust trim and showed a 0.81 s run on its own clock (TechCrunch); not yet independently timed.

Replying to a report that Michael Dell expects the memory chip crunch to get worse, Elon Musk wrote that it will last for sure in 2027, and that 2028 will be a different story if China ramps LPDDR5 and LPDDR6 production as fast as other products.

Replying to a post about an Anthropic estimate that AI could push US GDP to $44 trillion by 2030, Elon Musk wrote that more than 50% growth in useful US output by 2030 due to superintelligence is extremely likely, unless there is a major war.
Verdict: Pending → Delivered. Tesla produced its 10 millionth vehicle, a Model Y at Fremont, during the week of July 30 2026.
Verdict: Pending → Delivered. Tesla began Megapack 3 production at its Brookshire Megafactory outside Houston on August 6 2026.
Verdict: Pending → Delivered. Tesla flew the next-gen Roadster on cold-gas thrusters at SpaceX's McGregor site on October 15 2026, and Elon Musk posted that the future does have flying cars.
Verdict: Pending → Cancelled. Tesla's October 15 2026 Roadster reveal listed about 300 miles of range, dropping the 2017 620-mile spec.
Asked when customers get the new Roadster, Elon Musk told the McGregor event crowd that Tesla enters production in 2028.

Verdict: Pending → Delivered. Tesla unveiled the second-generation Roadster on October 15 2026 at SpaceX's McGregor test site near Waco, with a livestreamed demo of SpaceX thrusters (TechCrunch, fetched Oct 16).
Quoting Jensen Huang on SpaceX and Nvidia designing servers for data centers in space, Elon Musk wrote that their co-engineered Star Mind computer will reach volume production next year.
Quoting a post about memory-chip oversupply risks, Elon Musk wrote that China will be making a lot of RAM in 2028.
Elon Musk wrote that unless there is a major world war, SpaceX probably gets to more than $100 trillion in under 10 years, answering a post that cited Ron Baron’s lower $20–50 trillion range.
Asked about a forecast that AI would let every solo developer ship a high-quality game with no studio within one to two years, Elon Musk replied “Next year,” setting a 2027 deadline.

New prediction: Elon Musk first set the 3 TWh-a-year battery target at Battery Day 2020 and said on the July 2022 earnings call he was highly confident Tesla could do it by 2030.
Goalpost added: on Apr 14 2019 Musk recast the target as 'over 500k cars in next 12 months' (by Apr 2020). Tesla built roughly 390k in that span; 500k came in calendar 2020.

Graded Partial: Tesla grew from 64 to about 334 Supercharger stations in 2014 (141 in North America) and main corridors were covered, but large areas of North America and most of Eastern Europe had none.

Graded Missed: Starship Mk1 never flew. Its top bulkhead blew off during a pressure test on Nov 20 2019 and SpaceX retired the prototype. The first high-altitude Starship flight (SN8) came on Dec 9 2020.
Graded Delivered Late: The Starship update was held at Boca Chica on Sep 28 2019, about seven weeks after 'two weeks or so'.
Graded Delivered Late: Cuphead: Tesla Edition shipped in Software Version 10.0, which began rolling out on Sep 26 2019, about four weeks after August ended.
Earlier goalpost added: on Jan 26 2026 Musk tweeted 'Starship launch in 6 weeks' (about Mar 9). Flight 12 flew May 22.
Goalpost moved: on the Nov 2017 call Musk pushed 5,000 Model 3s a week to late Q1 2018, then in Feb 2018 to the end of Q2. Tesla hit it in the last week of June 2018.
Graded Delivered Late: The first European Model S deliveries happened in Oslo on Aug 7 2013, about four months after 'early' 2013.
Graded Delivered: Giga Shanghai delivered its first China-built Model 3s on Dec 30 2019, about two years after the call and ahead of the three-year target.
Graded Delivered: Tesla produced 509,737 vehicles and delivered 499,550 in 2020, hitting the half-million mark on production.
Graded Missed: Tesla produced 509,737 vehicles in 2020, about half of 1 million.
Graded Missed: Tesla produced 254,530 vehicles in 2018, about half the target.
Graded Missed: Tesla built 260 Model 3s in Q3 2017 and 2,425 in Q4 2017, about 2,700 in the half, under 3% of the low end.
Graded Missed: Tesla delivered 50,580 cars in 2015, short of 55,000.
Graded Delivered: Deliveries rose from 31,655 in 2014 to 50,580 in 2015 (+60%) and to 76,230 in 2016 (+51%).
Graded Missed: Tesla built 14,037 cars in Q4 2015, about 1,100 a week, roughly half the promised rate.
Graded Delivered: Tesla delivered 22,477 Model S cars in 2013.
New prediction: In January 2026 Elon Musk tweeted that humans would reach Mars in 5 to 10 years if civilization keeps advancing, putting the window at 2031-2036.
New prediction: At the Future Investment Initiative in October 2024 Elon Musk said there would be at least 10 billion humanoid robots by 2040, priced at $20,000-$25,000.

Graded Missed: No all-new low-cost Tesla platform began production in 2025. Tesla instead launched cheaper 'Standard' trims of the Model Y and Model 3 in October 2025 on existing lines. Cybercab, the next-gen platform's first product, began production at Giga Texas in 2026.
Graded Delivered Late: SpaceX did not reach that rate in 2020. At the Feb 10 2022 Starbase update Musk said SpaceX was now making about one Raptor a day, about 14 months late.

Graded Missed: Tesla never opened a Supercharger in Ukraine. Ukrainian press noted in 2021 that the promised Kyiv-area stations still had not appeared, so coverage did not reach 'Kiev' or 100% of Europe in 2019.
Goalpost moved: on the January 2019 earnings call Musk reset the 10,000-a-week rate to the end of 2019, with Shanghai's help. Tesla made about 105,000 cars in Q4 2019, roughly 8,000 a week.
Goalpost moved: on the April 2020 earnings call Musk reset the 1,000 Solar Roofs a week target to 'within the next year or maybe even by end of year'. Tesla never reported that rate.
Graded Delivered Late: Musk said Grokipedia v0.1 would be published within two weeks. It went live on October 27 2025, about nine days late, with about 885,000 articles.
Graded Delivered: Musk aimed for more than 150 Falcon flights in 2025. SpaceX flew 165 Falcon 9 orbital launches that year, a record.
Graded Delivered: Musk said Dragon would take astronauts farther from Earth than anyone in over 50 years during 2024. Polaris Dawn reached about 1,408 km in September 2024, the farthest since Apollo.
Graded Delivered Late: Musk said Grok 1.5 would be out in February 2024. xAI announced Grok-1.5 on March 28 2024 and rolled it out to users over the next weeks.

Graded Delivered Late: Musk said Grok would reach all Premium+ subscribers the next week. The rollout started on December 7 and was finished for US Premium+ users by December 8 2023, about a week late.
Graded Delivered Late: Musk said the Tesla diner in LA should be ready later in 2023. It opened in Hollywood on July 21 2025, about 19 months late.
Graded Delivered Late: Musk put Actually Smart Summon a month or two after mid-July 2023. Tesla released it on September 3 2024, about a year late.
Graded Delivered Late: Musk said SpaceX would attempt a Starship launch in March 2023. The first integrated flight launched on April 20 2023, about three weeks late.
Graded Delivered Late: Musk promised the recommendation code no later than February 2023. Twitter published it on GitHub on March 31 2023, a month late.
Graded Delivered: Musk promised a no-ads tier in 2023. X launched Premium+, with no ads in the For You and Following feeds, on October 27 2023.
Graded Delivered: Musk said the Semi would start shipping in 2022 and Cybertruck in 2023. Tesla delivered the first Semis to PepsiCo on December 1 2022 and the first Cybertrucks on November 30 2023.
Graded Missed: Musk said FSD Beta would reach left-hand-drive Europe in summer 2022. No customer beta launched in Europe that year; only test vehicles were seen in 2023.
Graded Delivered: Musk aimed for 60 Falcon launches in 2022. SpaceX flew 61, ending the year on December 30.
Graded Delivered Late: Musk said in August 2021 that the first orbital Starship stack would be ready to fly in a few weeks. The first integrated flight came on April 20 2023, about 20 months later.
Graded Partial: Musk expected a 7-seat Model S Plaid in production around Oct/Nov 2020. The Plaid launched on June 10 2021, seven months late, and only as a five-seater.
Graded Missed: Musk said the 2020 Hyperloop pod competition would run in a 10 km vacuum tunnel with a curve. The tunnel was never built and no 2020 competition was held.
Graded Delivered Late: Musk aimed to finish the Las Vegas Convention Center tunnel by end of 2019. Boring finished digging the second tunnel on May 14 2020, and the Loop opened to riders in 2021.
Graded Delivered Late: Musk looked forward to launching NASA astronauts to the ISS in 2018. Demo-2 carried Behnken and Hurley on May 30 2020, about 17 months late.
Graded Delivered Late: Musk said in December 2017 that Falcon Heavy would launch the next month. It first flew on February 6 2018, a week late.
Graded Delivered: Musk said in September 2015 that Model 3 production would start in about two years. The first production Model 3 was built at Fremont in early July 2017.
Graded Delivered Late: Musk hoped to unveil SpaceX's new spacesuit by end of 2013. He posted the first photo of it on August 23 2017, three and a half years late.
Graded Delivered Late: Musk said in July 2012 he would publish the Hyperloop design in about four weeks. The Hyperloop Alpha paper came out on August 12 2013, about a year late.
New prediction: On Tesla's April 2026 earnings call Elon Musk said Tesla was building a second Optimus factory at Giga Texas that would probably start production around summer 2027.
Graded Missed: Musk predicted a pretty difficult recession in 2023. There was none: US real GDP grew 2.5% in 2023.
Graded Delivered Late: Musk said in January 2021 that Model S Plaid deliveries would start the next month. Tesla held the Plaid delivery event on June 10 2021, about three and a half months late.
Graded Missed: Musk hoped for a wide FSD Beta release by end of 2020. It stayed limited to a few thousand testers; Tesla opened it to all North American FSD buyers in November 2022.
Graded Delivered: Musk said Tesla would announce its European Gigafactory location before end of 2019. On November 12 2019 he announced it would be built near Berlin.
Graded Delivered: Musk targeted 1.8 million deliveries in 2023. Tesla delivered 1,808,581.
Graded Delivered: Musk guessed in July 2022 that inflation would decline toward year end. US CPI inflation peaked at 9.1% in June 2022 and fell to 6.5% by December.
Graded Missed: Musk was confident of at least 50% growth in 2022. Tesla delivered 1.31 million cars in 2022, up 40%; production rose 47%.
Graded Delivered: Musk expected Tesla to be profitable in Q3 2019. Tesla reported a surprise Q3 2019 net profit of $143 million.
